$comment: The challenge's content, Adam's to change: the effects a slice carries, the summons they bring, and the kinds of challenge progressions are drawn from. A first draft, planned with Adam on 2026-10-20, every name and number in it to be tuned. Not in the game yet: the simulator on /admin/inspect-challenges runs the server's engine on what is here, and shows and edits it; the game server takes on a change while it runs. The numbers that belong to no one entry are the balance's. See docs/plans/challenges.md and decision record 0105.

effects.$comment: Each aspect's effects by their ids, three to an aspect, of which a slice of that aspect carries two. A trigger fires each time a happening puts its slice on stage; a passive works for as long as it stays there. An effect's words name its numbers in braces, which the page fills in; one that summons names the summon, whose own numbers are below; one with a slot fits a keyFigure, lending one of their stats, or a structure, and one whose slot is onTheLine puts what is in it into the challenge as a summon. The aspect boost, half as much again, grows what an effect does and never a chance or a cost. The names are a first draft for Adam to change.

sellswords.name: Sellswords
sellswords.words: Hires a Mercenary, who pulls for this side every second.

noQuarter.name: No Quarter
noQuarter.words: Each Mercenary act: {chance}% chance to also kill an enemy summon it can beat.

spoils.name: Spoils of the Field
spoils.words: +{amount} when the happening changes away from Violence.

envoy.name: Trusted Envoy
envoy.words: Adds the envoy's kindness to the tug.

sweeterTerms.name: Sweeter Terms
sweeterTerms.words: Turns each enemy summon: {strong}% if power beats its integrity, else {weak}%. No room: it deserts.

parley.name: Endless Parley
parley.words: +{perSecond} a second; while the opponent leads, their power is {power} lower.

rebuke.name: Divine Rebuke
rebuke.words: An enemy summon acts: {chance}% chance every enemy slice loses {integrity} integrity.

ordination.name: Ordination
ordination.words: Ordains a Priest, who pulls by how far this side's integrity beats the enemy's.

sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
sanctuary.words: Puts the building on the line the first time on stage; +{piety} piety if won.

counsel.name: Learned Counsel
counsel.words: Adds the counsellor's reason to the tug.

refutation.name: Refutation
refutation.words: {chance}% chance to cancel each enemy trigger.

seenThrough.name: Seen Through
seenThrough.words: An enemy summon acts: {chance}% chance of +{amount}.

watch.name: Raise the Watch
watch.words: Raises an Enforcer: costs this side, silences the enemy's hardest-pulling summon.

decree.name: By Decree
decree.words: {chance}% chance to stop each act of an enemy summon this slice's power beats.

firmHand.name: The Firm Hand
firmHand.words: While this side leads, the opponent's power is {power} lower.

commons.name: Raise the Commons
commons.words: Raises a Rebel, who pulls harder while this side is behind.

againstTheGrain.name: Against the Grain
againstTheGrain.words: +{amount} when on stage by the draw, matching no aspect of the happening.

ownWill.name: Will of One's Own
ownWill.words: Once a challenge, at a change of happening, this slice stays on stage regardless.

countingHouse.name: Counting House
countingHouse.words: Puts the building on the line when on stage; +{wealth} wealth if won.

farmTaxes.name: Farm the Taxes
farmTaxes.words: Hires a Collector: costs this side, fills a coffer that pours at the next happening or the end.

pickBones.name: Pick the Bones
pickBones.words: +{amount} whenever an enemy summon is killed.

patron.name: Open-Handed Patron
patron.words: Adds the patron's kindness to the tug.

alms.name: Give Alms
alms.words: Sends out a Benefactor, who pulls harder while this side is behind.

remembered.name: Remembered Kindness
remembered.words: +{amount} whenever a summon of this side is killed.

wildHunt.name: The Wild Hunt
wildHunt.words: Looses a Predator, who pulls, or now and then kills an enemy summon it can beat.

teeming.name: Teeming Wilds
teeming.words: An enemy summon acts: {chance}% chance a Creature comes to this side.

wildRemembers.name: The Wild Remembers
wildRemembers.words: +{amount} when the happening changes away from Nature.

engines.name: Raise the Engines
engines.words: Builds a Machine, which pulls for this side every second.

works.name: Works and Forges
works.words: Puts the building on the line when on stage.

wellOiled.name: Well-Oiled
wellOiled.words: A summon of this side acts: {chance}% chance it pulls {amount} more.

summons.$comment: Each summon by its id: what it is called, its aspect, which its boost is judged by, and its numbers, which its words name. A summon acts once a second from the second after it arrives, until it is killed, turned or the challenge ends; its integrity is its slice's at the moment it was summoned. A building or a person put on the line is a summon too, made by the balance's rule rather than listed here.

priest.name: Priest
priest.words: Pulls its side's integrity lead over the enemy's, times {share}.

enforcer.name: Enforcer
enforcer.words: Costs its side {costs} a second; silences the hardest-pulling enemy summon {silences} seconds.

rebel.name: Rebel
rebel.words: Pulls {pulls} a second, {behind} while its side is behind.

collector.name: Collector
collector.words: Costs its side {costs} a second, puts {deposits} in its coffer; the coffer is lost if it dies.

benefactor.name: Benefactor
benefactor.words: Pulls {pulls} a second, {behind} while its side is behind.

predator.name: Predator
predator.words: Pulls {pulls} a second, or {kills}% chance to kill an enemy summon it can beat instead.

kinds.$comment: Each challenge kind by its id: the seconds a challenge of it lasts and the happenings it has, each the least and the most, the chance out of a hundred that a happening has a second aspect, and how much each aspect weighs when a happening's aspects are drawn. A kind never has more happenings than the fewest seconds it lasts, so each begins on a second of its own.

debate.name: Debate
debate.words: Scholars arguing a point before an audience.

tradeWar.name: Trade war
tradeWar.words: Merchants and their princes fighting over a market.

sermon.name: Sermon
sermon.words: A preacher winning a crowd, or losing it.
